hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFT strategy token pools that enforces a flat 10% fee on all swaps, distributing 80% to the NFT strategy contract, 10% to the launcher/creator, and 10% to a protocol fee address. Pool initialization and liquidity additions are restricted to the NFTStrategyFactory; exact-output swaps are blocked.
